updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.8.14  
 - Adds OKB EFB Tab layers MIZ (DCS Draw Layer) and SAM threats (live from the AWACS Threat tab) 
 - OKN Out fix FLT PLN Tab NAVLOG width handling 
 - OKB Out UI checkbox addition for Allow LAN Connection (Turns on LAN pipeline and requests to open OKB port for private connection only) 
 - OKB Out FLT PLN Tab AH-64D Apache DTC Handling And new module specific Comms Panel UI 
 - Redesign DTC import for all modules to feed a common OKB side conical collecter and allow easier render paths. 
 - Refactor OKB Out to make long tern support and coding easier, break out CSS and JS code.
 - Fix Syria ICAO airport codes missing for some airports. 
 - Fix System.globalisation for Frequency string reading and decimal managment.
 - Style update for OKB FLT PLN Tab page and make right rail tabs narrower. 
 - OKB Out ATA auto function rework and bug fixes 
 - OKB iOS Out landscape mode CSS adjustments to move Tab Bar and EFB map controls for this orientation. 
 - New OKB Out bug fixes for stability and COM/Rout Tab including Map markers. 
 - Move some EFB tab controls to suit landscape orientation in iOS if used like that. 
 - New profiling debug for Dev team to look at server processing performance on large missions.
 - Adds Map Marker dialog popups on OKB Out EFB Tab Moving Map.
 - New Ground Crew commands for Open DTC manager/Open DTC Editor Opens aircrafts DTC manager when on ground.
 - Many process server messages caching and performance improvements and logging. 
 - Add compass symbol back to EFB Moving Map and fix regression in landscape mode iOS Out with lower rail global controls osition. 
 - OKB stabilise map and overlays view for Moving Map when in North Up follow me mode 
 - OKB adjust night mode texturs on some UI elements.
 - OKB new Draw layer controls now has draw toggle, eraser and reset on all tabs, Drawings are tab independent and work on both OKB Out and iOS Out. 
 - limit use of LoGetWorldObjects to 60 sec server process, use cached data as fallback for objects if needed, peformance improvemnet on heavy server and unit rich missions. 
 - New OKB Allow LAN Connection dual private and public firewall port configuration.
